description: Slot-relative timing: each fraction divides a measurement by the slot duration of the fork that applies to the measured slot, next to the existing seconds metrics. Keep 10s and 12s nodes as separate series; compare matched runs with their chain config and software versions recorded.

panels.description: Slot duration of the fork at the current clock slot, per beacon node. Changes at a slot-duration fork activation.

targets.expr: lodestar_slot_duration_seconds{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}

panels.title: Slot duration (current clock slot fork)

panels.description: Shows when each node's slot duration changed. Fraction samples before and after the change are divided by the duration of the measured slot, not this gauge.

targets.expr: lodestar_slot_duration_seconds{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}

panels.title: Slot duration over time

panels.description: Completions after a slot-relative deadline. Each task has a matched denominator below: become-head fraction count, preparation margin count, or PTC-eligible completions. A miss places completion after a reference time and does not by itself show CPU interference.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, deadline, task) (rate(lodestar_deadline_missed_total{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])) * 3600

panels.title: Deadline misses per hour

panels.description: Time from block slot start to receipt, divided by the duration of the block's slot. Series are kept per instance so 10s and 12s cohorts stay separate: do not read a pooled percentile across them.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance, source) (rate(lodestar_gossip_block_arrival_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, source) (rate(lodestar_gossip_block_arrival_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Block arrival (fraction of block slot)

panels.description: Same measurement in seconds from the existing histogram. Compare with the fraction panel: unchanged seconds with a larger fraction means the same work consumes more of a shorter slot.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance, source) (rate(lodestar_gossip_block_elapsed_time_till_received_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, source) (rate(lodestar_gossip_block_elapsed_time_till_received_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Block arrival (seconds)

panels.description: Time from head slot start to the block becoming head, divided by the head slot's duration. Only heads less than an epoch old are sampled. Series are kept per instance so 10s and 12s cohorts stay separate: do not read a pooled percentile across them.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_import_block_become_head_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_import_block_become_head_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Block become head (fraction of head slot)

panels.description: Same measurement in seconds from the existing histogram, same recent-head population.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_gossip_block_elapsed_time_till_become_head_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_gossip_block_elapsed_time_till_become_head_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Block become head (seconds)

panels.description: Share of sampled recent heads that became head after the attestation due point of the head slot's fork. Numerator and denominator share the recent-head population. Empty when no heads were sampled.

targets.expr:
sum by (instance) (rate(lodestar_deadline_missed_total{deadline="attestation_due", task="block_become_head", job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval]))
/
sum by (instance) (rate(lodestar_import_block_become_head_slot_fraction_count{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval]))

panels.title: Heads set after attestation due (proportion)

panels.description: Denominator of the proportion panel: recent heads sampled per hour.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(lodestar_import_block_become_head_slot_fraction_count{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])) * 3600

panels.title: Sampled heads per hour

panels.description: TypeScript state transition only: the same timer as the seconds histogram, divided by the duration of the slot the transition enters. A node running the native state transition shows no data here, never zero.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_stfn_epoch_transition_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_stfn_epoch_transition_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Epoch transition (fraction of entered slot)

panels.description: Existing TypeScript epoch transition timer in seconds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_stfn_epoch_transition_seconds_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_stfn_epoch_transition_seconds_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Epoch transition (seconds)

panels.description: Signed fraction of the scheduling slot left when prepareNextSlot finished for the first slot of the next epoch. Negative means it finished after that slot began. Covers regen, state hashing and awaited payload preparation. Quantiles come from bucket rates; the signed _sum is never rated.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.05, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_prepare_next_slot_lead_margin_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group", slot_position="epoch_end"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_prepare_next_slot_lead_margin_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group", slot_position="epoch_end"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Preparation margin at epoch end (fraction of scheduling slot)

panels.description: Same measurement for slots that are not the last of an epoch, where no epoch transition is precomputed.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.05, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_prepare_next_slot_lead_margin_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group", slot_position="other"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_prepare_next_slot_lead_margin_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group", slot_position="other"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Preparation margin on other slots (fraction of scheduling slot)

panels.description: Existing timer around the epoch-end preparation, in seconds, for both state transition backends.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_precompute_next_epoch_transition_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(lodestar_precompute_next_epoch_transition_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Epoch-end preparation duration (seconds)

panels.description: Successful completions reaching the margin observation, by slot position. Errors and skips never reach it: see the result panel.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, slot_position) (rate(lodestar_prepare_next_slot_lead_margin_slot_fraction_count{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])) * 3600

panels.title: Preparation samples per hour

panels.description: Share of successful preparations, across both slot positions, that finished after the prepared slot began. Empty when there were no completions.

targets.expr:
sum by (instance) (rate(lodestar_deadline_missed_total{deadline="next_slot_start", task="prepare_next_slot", job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval]))
/
sum by (instance) (rate(lodestar_prepare_next_slot_lead_margin_slot_fraction_count{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval]))

panels.title: Preparation finished after next slot start (proportion)

panels.description: Existing success, skip and error outcomes of the epoch-end preparation. Only successes enter the margin and proportion panels.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, result) (rate(lodestar_precompute_next_epoch_transition_result_total{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])) * 3600

panels.title: Preparation results per hour

panels.description: Time from payload slot start to envelope import, divided by that slot's duration, by execution status. Only payloads of the current or previous clock slot are sampled, so this is lateness among near-current imports, not payload success or network propagation time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance, status) (rate(lodestar_import_payload_elapsed_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, status) (rate(lodestar_import_payload_elapsed_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Payload import (fraction of payload slot)

panels.description: Existing seconds histogram over every import, including catch-up, by envelope source. Its population is wider than the fraction panel.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance, source) (rate(lodestar_import_payload_elapsed_time_till_imported_seconds_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, source) (rate(lodestar_import_payload_elapsed_time_till_imported_seconds_bucket{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Payload import (seconds, all imports)

panels.description: Share of near-current imports completed after the payload due point of the payload slot's fork, by execution status. Same population as the fraction panel. Payloads that never arrive produce no sample.

targets.expr:
sum by (instance, status) (rate(lodestar_import_payload_deadline_missed_total{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval]))
/
sum by (instance, status) (rate(lodestar_import_payload_elapsed_slot_fraction_count{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval]))

panels.title: Payload imported after payload due (proportion)

panels.description: Sampled near-current imports against imports for older slots that were excluded. Excluded imports mix catch-up with genuine stalls; a rising excluded rate on a synced node deserves a look.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, status) (rate(lodestar_import_payload_elapsed_slot_fraction_count{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])) * 3600
sum by (instance) (rate(lodestar_import_payload_beyond_window_total{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])) * 3600

panels.title: Payload imports sampled and excluded per hour

panels.description: Share of successful epoch-end preparations in a Gloas or later slot that finished after that slot's payload attestation due point. Async EL waits can cause this without blocking the PTC duty. Empty before Gloas or without completions.

targets.expr:
sum by (instance) (rate(lodestar_deadline_missed_total{deadline="payload_attestation_due", task="prepare_next_slot_completion", job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval]))
/
sum by (instance) (rate(lodestar_prepare_next_slot_ptc_eligible_completions_total{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval]))

panels.title: Epoch-end preparation finished after PTC due (proportion)

panels.description: Denominator and numerator of the proportion panel, so zero misses with completions and no completions stay distinguishable.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(lodestar_prepare_next_slot_ptc_eligible_completions_total{job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])) * 3600

sum by (instance) (rate(lodestar_deadline_missed_total{deadline="payload_attestation_due", task="prepare_next_slot_completion", job=~"$beacon_job", instance=~"$bn_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])) * 3600

panels.title: PTC-eligible preparation completions per hour

panels.description: Offset from the configured attestation due point when produce and publish were called, divided by the duty slot's duration. Negative means before due: a block arrived early.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vc_attester_produce_attestation_margin_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vc_attester_produce_attestation_margin_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vc_attester_publish_attestation_margin_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vc_attester_publish_attestation_margin_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Attestation produce and publish offset from due (fraction of duty slot)

panels.description: Existing seconds histograms of the same offsets.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vc_attester_step_call_produce_attestation_seconds_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vc_attester_step_call_produce_attestation_seconds_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vc_attester_step_call_publish_attestation_seconds_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vc_attester_step_call_publish_attestation_seconds_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: Attestation produce and publish offset from due (seconds)

panels.description: Offset from the payload attestation due point when the publish call was made, divided by the duty slot's duration, split by epoch-end and other slots. Measures the call, not delivery. A positive offset is expected: the routine can start at due, then produce and sign before publishing.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance, slot_position) (rate(vc_ptc_publish_payload_attestation_margin_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, slot_position) (rate(vc_ptc_publish_payload_attestation_margin_slot_fraction_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

panels.title: PTC publish offset from due (fraction of duty slot)

panels.description: Existing seconds histogram of the publish offset, with sign and publish errors per hour on the same axis.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vc_ptc_step_call_publish_payload_attestation_seconds_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vc_ptc_step_call_publish_payload_attestation_seconds_bucket{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])))
sum by (instance, error) (rate(vc_ptc_service_errors{job=~"$validator_job", instance=~"$vc_instance", network=~"$network", group=~"$group"}[$rate_interval])) * 3600
